content: People complained about it getting cancelled so they made slight adjustments and brought it back. Community is divided on this so saying nobody wanted it is not correct. It is a system that is not mandatory so you can still choose not to bind. But if you do, you get a lil extra stats with the downside of not being able to use it with other awakers. And you can still unbind so it is not permanent. Not having a downside is just a 50% mainstat buff to all covenants lol.
